snippet.title: Starting Your First Franchise In Geeked-Out Basketball
snippet.description:
How to start a new career in Geeked-Out Basketball, step by step. This tutorial walks through signing up for the alpha, answering Coach Sammy's six setup questions, reading your recommended jobs, browsing all 128 programs with filters, and taking over Hana Road, the lowest-ranked team in the nation.

New players can get into the alpha with the access code ITSGOOD (all caps, no spaces) while codes last.

Play the alpha: https://geekedoutbasketball.com/
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5148870/GeekedOut_Basketball/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/mTXvY37p22
Official trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7PEJfMVySSg

CHAPTERS
0:00 Intro
0:28 Sign up and the alpha access code
1:41 Find your program and meet Coach Sammy
3:14 The six setup questions
6:11 Your recommended jobs
7:01 Reviewing a roster before you commit
8:13 Win-now jobs and rebuilds
10:05 News, rankings and recruiting leans
11:38 Browsing all 128 jobs with filters
14:44 League rankings, schedule, rosters and recruiting pool
15:49 Taking the job and naming your coach
16:35 What changes in every new franchise
17:31 Training camp, coming next video
18:32 Alpha access and the Discord

ABOUT GEEKED-OUT BASKETBALL
Geeked-Out Basketball (GOB) is a deep tactical basketball management sim, think Football Manager or OOTP for basketball, set in an original universe. It's desktop-first and built for hardcore sports-sim and franchise-mode fans who want real decisions on recruiting, roster building, training and game strategy. No pay-to-win.

#GeekedOutBasketball #BasketballSim #SportsManagement #Tutorial #IndieGame
